items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 5, 2021 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: Billy Eckstine, the headliner with Bobby Tucker played piano, and Sarah Vaughan and Roy Haynes and Jimmy Jones on piano... For two months, can you do better than that if you want to play with people?

ctx.x: The question was does Terry Gibbs think that there were good old days in his life? And it seems like almost without exception they were all —

All great. Really okay. There was really something every year that was really great and stuck out you know. And let me tell you, let’s face it, when you get a chance growing up listening to Benny Goodman and Duke Ellington and get to know these people, get to know these people. You know like I’ve been on the scene with the Dream Band one time when Duke Ellington introduced the band, and I didn’t want to follow it, because that introduction was so great that whatever I played, it would be ridiculous. I mean Duke…
Southern, Phineas Newborn, Bud Powell. For two months, can you do better than that if you want to play with people? Who’s left?

items.title: Terry Gibbs interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 12, 2001 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: The biggest show I’d ever been in with my life... Headliners... Billy Eckstine... That was one show.

ctx.x: He was a bigot. An out and out bigot. He had him on the show and Lester was saying to Dick Cavett he says, “Wait a minute” he says, “I’m not prejudiced at all, not at all, I don’t see any difference between black and white.” So Dick says, “You’d better buy a pair of glasses because there’s a big difference between black and white.” I never looked at it as color. I wanted the best musicians in my band. Because where I lived on the east coast, I went out with the quartet I had was Terry Pollard for four years, I…

And she had Jimmy Jones playing piano, Roy Haynes playing and Richard Davis. So that’s that trio. Count Basie band with Joe Williams. Now this is one show. Count Basie and Joe Williams. Phineas Newborn’s trio. Bud Powell’s trio. Lester Young’s trio. Zoot Sims, Chet Baker’s group and Jeri Southern. That was one show. But then unfortunately Chet Baker’s band, they all got busted. After we were out about three days Jeri Southern got fired because she was half drunk all the time and soon had other commitments. So I…
